title: OEDS London Smart Meter Households
description: UK Power Networks Low Carbon London trial: half-hourly smart meter consumption of about 5,500 London households, 2011-11 to 2014-02.

list.name: household
list.label: Household
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT "LCLid" FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE "DateTime" >= '2013-01-01' AND "DateTime" < '2013-01-02' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT "LCLid" FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE "DateTime" >= '2013-01-01' AND "DateTime" < '2013-01-02' ORDER BY 1
list.description: Household id (LCLid) from a sample day in 2013; some households have data only in other periods.

panels.title: londondatastore.consumption
panels.description: First and latest timestamp and approximate rows (168 million half-hourly values). Static dataset without live updates. Keep the time range to a few weeks; 1 month takes a few seconds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(epoch from min("DateTime"))*1000)::bigint as "First", (extract(epoch from max("DateTime"))*1000)::bigint as "Latest", approximate_row_count('londondatastore.consumption'::regclass) as "Rows (approx.)"
FROM londondatastore.consumption

panels.title: Selected range
panels.description: Mean demand per household in kW (kWh per half hour x 2), mean daily consumption per household, and number of households with data in the range. Std = standard flat tariff (14.228 p/kWh), ToU = dynamic time-of-use (Dynamic ToU) tariff with day-ahead prices High 67.20 / Normal 11.76 / Low 3.99 p/kWh signalled during 2013. The price signals themselves are not part of the data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(power)*2 AS "Mean demand", avg(power)*48 AS "Consumption per household", count(DISTINCT "LCLid") AS "Households", count(DISTINCT "LCLid") FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'ToU') AS "ToU households"
FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime")

panels.title: Mean demand per household by tariff
panels.description: Mean demand per household (kW) for standard and ToU tariff households per time bin. On winter evenings the average household draws ~0.9 kW. Std = standard flat tariff (14.228 p/kWh), ToU = dynamic time-of-use (Dynamic ToU) tariff with day-ahead prices High 67.20 / Normal 11.76 / Low 3.99 p/kWh signalled during 2013. The price signals themselves are not part of the data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("DateTime",$__interval), tariff, avg(power)*2 AS "Mean demand" FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime") AND tariff IN ('Std','ToU') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Households with data per day
panels.description: Number of households that delivered readings per day: the trial grew over the first months, then households dropped out.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("DateTime",'1d'), count(DISTINCT "LCLid") AS "Households" FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Typical day by tariff
panels.description: Mean demand per household by half hour of the day (Europe/London local time), standard vs ToU tariff, weekdays and weekends. The evening peak (~17:30-19:30) is the load that dynamic tariffs try to shift.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(hour from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')*2 + floor(extract(minute from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')/30))::int/2.0 AS "Hour of day", 2*avg(power) FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'Std' AND extract(isodow from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') < 6) AS "Std weekday", 2*avg(power) FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'Std' AND extract(isodow from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') >= 6) AS "Std weekend", 2*avg(power) FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'ToU' AND extract(isodow from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') < 6) AS "ToU weekday", 2*avg(power) FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'ToU' AND extract(isodow from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') >= 6) AS "ToU weekend"
FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ToU relative to standard tariff
panels.description: Difference of the mean demand of ToU households to standard tariff households by half hour of the day, in percent of the standard demand (weekdays). Negative values at the evening peak would indicate load shifting; the effect is visible only on high-price days and averaged here over all days of the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT h AS "Hour of day", 100.0*(tou - std)/NULLIF(std, 0) AS "ToU vs Std (%)" FROM (SELECT (extract(hour from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')*2 + floor(extract(minute from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')/30))::int/2.0 AS h, avg(power) FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'ToU') AS tou, avg(power) FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'Std') AS std FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime") AND extract(isodow from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') < 6 GROUP BY 1) x ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Distribution of daily household consumption
panels.description: Share of household-days per daily consumption class (kWh/day) for both tariffs. Typical London households use 4-14 kWh per day with a long tail of high users.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lpad((c*2)::text, 2, '0') || '-' || (c*2+2) || ' kWh' AS "Class", 100.0*max(n) FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'Std')/sum(max(n) FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'Std')) OVER () AS "Std", 100.0*max(n) FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'ToU')/sum(max(n) FILTER (WHERE tariff = 'ToU')) OVER () AS "ToU" FROM (SELECT tariff, c, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT tariff, least(floor(sum(power)/2), 15)::int AS c FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime") GROUP BY "LCLid", tariff, date_trunc('day', "DateTime") HAVING count(*) >= 44) z GROUP BY 1,2) y GROUP BY c ORDER BY c

panels.title: Top 10 households by consumption
panels.description: Households with the highest mean daily consumption in the selected range (only households with at least 90 % of the half hours).

targets.rawSql: SELECT "LCLid" AS "Household", max(tariff) AS "Tariff", sum(power)/GREATEST(1, count(*)/48.0) AS "Consumption (kWh/day)", max(power)*2 AS "Peak (kW)", count(*) AS "Readings" FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime") GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 0.9*extract(epoch from ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))/1800 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Seasonal pattern: consumption per household on the 15th of each month
panels.description: Mean daily consumption per household (kWh/day) for one sample day (the 15th, UTC) per month over the whole trial period, to stay fast on 168 million rows; independent of the time range. Winter consumption (about 13-14 kWh/day) is roughly 60 % higher than summer (about 8 kWh/day).

panels.title: Demand of $household
panels.description: Half-hourly demand of the selected household in kW (readings are kWh per half hour).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("DateTime",$__interval), avg(power)*2 AS "Demand", max(power)*2 AS "Maximum" FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime") AND "LCLid" = '$household' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily energy of $household
panels.description: Daily consumption of the selected household in kWh; days with missing half hours are underestimated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("DateTime",'1d'), sum(power) AS "Energy" FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime") AND "LCLid" = '$household' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Typical day of $household vs. average household
panels.description: Mean demand by half hour of the day (Europe/London) of the selected household compared to the mean over all households in the same range (weekdays).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (extract(hour from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')*2 + floor(extract(minute from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')/30))::int/2.0 AS "Hour of day", 2*avg(power) FILTER (WHERE "LCLid" = '$household') AS "$household", avg(power)*2 AS "All households" FROM londondatastore.consumption WHERE $__timeFilter("DateTime") AND extract(isodow from "DateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London') < 6 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
